name: ARK: Survival Ascended
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The dinosaur survival game rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Proton and keeps it updated, with CurseForge mods by ID.
startup: mkdir -p ShooterGame/Saved/Logs; rm -f ShooterGame/Saved/Logs/ShooterGame.log; proton run ./ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/ArkAscendedServer.exe "{{SERVER_MAP}}?listen?SessionName={{SESSION_NAME}}?Port={{SERVER_PORT}}?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort={{RCON_PORT}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}?ServerAdminPassword={{ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}${SERVER_PASSWORD:+?ServerPassword=$SERVER_PASSWORD}$([ "{{SERVER_PVE}}" = 1 ] && echo ?ServerPVE=True){{ARGS_PARAMS}}" -WinLiveMaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -oldconsole -servergamelog ${MOD_IDS:+-mods=$MOD_IDS} $([ "{{BATTLE_EYE}}" = 1 ] || echo -NoBattlEye) {{ARGS_FLAGS}} & pid=$!; tail -n +1 -F ShooterGame/Saved/Logs/ShooterGame.log --pid=$pid 2>/dev/null & rc() { rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$1"; }; while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do read -r -t 2 line; r=$?; if [ $r -gt 128 ]; then continue; elif [ $r -ne 0 ]; then wait $pid; break; fi; case "$line" in "") ;; stop) echo "Saving the world and stopping the server."; rc SaveWorld; rc DoExit; wait $pid; break ;; *) rc "$line" || echo "The server isn't taking commands yet; it does once it has started." ;; esac; done

config.startup: {"done": "Server has completed startup and is now advertising for join"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ARK: Survival Ascended. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2430930) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously (the Windows version, run under Proton).
# Saves and configs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2430930}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)
echo "Installed ARK: Survival Ascended build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to run, such as TheIsland_WP, ScorchedEarth_WP, TheCenter_WP, Aberration_WP, Extinction_WP, Ragnarok_WP or Valguero_WP.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for admin commands in game and for the console, which talks to the server over RCON.

variables.name: PvE
variables.description: Players can't hurt each other or their bases. Off is PvP.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: CurseForge project IDs of the mods to load, separated by commas; the server downloads them at start.

variables.name: Extra options
variables.description: More map options, each as ?Option=value, such as ?AllowFlyerCarryPvE=True.

variables.name: Extra flags
variables.description: More launch flags, such as -ForceAllowCaveFlyers or -crossplay.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port the console talks to the server on (over RCON); give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Proton.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
